name: Sermorelin

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A 29-amino-acid fragment of growth hormone-releasing hormone. The former US product (Geref) was withdrawn from marketing; material in current use is supplied through compounding pharmacies rather than as an approved product.

systems.note: Stimulates somatotroph GH release; placed on the pituitary by intended effect.
Sought for its downstream anabolic and body-composition effect.
Raised GH exposure antagonises insulin action.

monitors.why: The only practical index of achieved GH exposure.
